—all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with…
“Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do…
Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of…
They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the…
The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bulls…
even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

parallels.note: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin…

translations.web: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.
translations.bsb: Then he is to take the bull outside the camp and burn it, just as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.
translations.kjv: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.
translations.asv: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bullock: it is the sin-offering for the assembly.
